english.note: Use 物件 for a physical object or item, including an article of clothing viewed as an object.
Use this for a clearly identifiable physical object or item of equipment rather than the all-purpose 嘢.

examples.english: This article was a gift from my mother.
examples.traditional: 呢件物件係我阿媽送畀我嘅。
